evidence.excerpt: To make prompt engineering scalable across the ensemble, we integrate a task-grounded Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) loop into both stages.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On five BEIR benchmarks (NQ, SciFact, FiQA, Touche-2020, DBPedia), MERGE improves BM25 nDCG@10 over the original queries by +2.1 to +14.9 points and matches or outperforms strong LLM-based query-expansion baselines despite using only compact open-source models.
